notes: Same mechanism and outcome as inj-026: fails fast (observed 6 s, log ~14 KB, no pip output), not late. BuildKit checksums each COPY source up front to compute its cache key, so the missing source fails before any RUN step executes, even though this COPY ([8/9]) is the last COPY. In the log, steps [2/9]-[7/9] show as CACHED, the FROM step is CANCELED, and the build ends with 'ERROR: failed to build: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/evall": not found' at Dockerfile:38. eval/ is only partly excluded by .dockerignore (eval/results/* except the two scored files), so the real directory is in the context and only the misspelled source is missing. In the build category (019-028), 025 and 028 are the only late failures: a RUN step can only fail when it executes, and theirs are the only failing RUN steps placed after the multi-minute pip install. 023 and 024 also fail in RUN steps, but those steps are the apt-get and pip install themselves, so they fail early.
